Disappointing service and a fish full of bones
Sep 2026 • Couples
We came to Tầm Vị with high expectations because of its Michelin star. The flavors were genuinely very good, especially the caramelized pork with egg and the Cá Kho Tộ, but unfortunately the overall experience was far below what we expected.

First, they forgot our fish and accidentally served it to another table. My wife had already finished her entire meal by the time I asked where my dish was. The waiter then told me they had forgotten about it and that it wasn’t his fault, but his colleague’s.

When the fish finally arrived, the waiter asked if I wanted rice with it. Given the mistake and the long delay, I specifically said I would take it if it was complimentary. To my surprise, the rice was still added to our bill.

The biggest disappointment, however, was the Cá Kho Tộ. The flavor was excellent, but the fish was absolutely full of bones. I had to carefully inspect almost every bite and eventually left more than half of the dish because I simply didn’t feel comfortable eating it. I later found that other guests have mentioned the same issue.

There are clearly some very good flavors coming out of this kitchen, but between the fish and the service mistakes, our experience simply did not meet the standard we expected from a Michelin-starred restaurant.

An unforgettable Michelin-starred experience: the true essence of Vietnamese cuisine!
Aug 2026 • Couples
Tầm Vị deserves 5 full stars and praise. As it is a Michelin-starred restaurant, expectations were high, but they were widely exceeded from every point of view!
The environment and the staff:
The place is simply enchanting: a unique, intimate, warm atmosphere with attention to the smallest details, which transports you into an elegant traditional Vietnamese house of times past. The staff is the real added value: friendly, thoughtful, and attentive as is rarely found. You feel pampered from the first to the last moment.
The cuisine and the dishes:
The food fully confirms the restaurant's reputation. We tried several traditional specialties made to perfection:
 Chả lá lốt (meat rolls in betel leaves), very fragrant and tasty;
 Thịt kho trứng (braised pork with eggs), tender, rich, and perfectly balanced;
 Tôm rang thịt ba chỉ (shrimp and pork belly stir-fry);
 Mực xào cần tỏi dứa (squid stir-fried with celery, garlic, and pineapple), very fresh and crunchy;
 Canh hến/ngao nấu chua (sweet and sour soup with clams/mussels), comforting and with an authentic taste;
 Everything accompanied by delicious white rice (Cơm trắng), a classic omelet (Trứng rán), vegetables sautéed with garlic, and refreshing honey and lime drinks (Chanh mật ong).
Those who criticize this place simply expect Western-style cuisine in a Vietnamese starred restaurant, or they failed to appreciate the true gastronomic essence of this wonderful country. Here, home-style Northern Vietnamese cuisine is celebrated at the highest levels of refinement.
Value for money:
For two people, we spent a little over 1.3 million VND (about €48-50 in total including taxes), an incredibly accessible and unbeatable price for a restaurant of this level.
One fundamental piece of advice: book well in advance because finding a table is almost impossible otherwise. A unique gastronomic experience that is absolutely worth it!

Mmm
Aug 2026 • Couples
We arrived to find our booking gone. The reservation was confirmed by email, but they had no record of it. After 15 minutes they seated us in the garden, outside with no air conditioning, which was uncomfortable.
The food was more encouraging:

 • Grapefruit and shrimp salad (9/10) – Really good, though still a fairly standard salad.
 • Steamed rice (10/10) – Perfect.
 • Caramelized pork with egg (5/10) – The pork itself was excellent, but it was too fatty and not actually caramelized.
 • Pork rolls (5/10) – Cabbage was the only flavor coming through.
 • Small fried shrimp (4/10) – Nothing memorable.

Dessert: we wanted to order two of the 3 dessert and the waitress told us that one is not good, the one we ordered either.

Overall, a solid place with capable kitchen staff, but between the lost reservation and the slow service, I’ve had better experiences elsewhere.
